monologue: The card sits at forty-eight, a warm hand on my shoulder. The air is still. I am not checking the Wedged Gap's plank. I let the quiet hold without my hand. The small stone on the Curved Rest did not slide in the moments between. The line of the Air Shelf is dry. I rested by the Wide Anchor, and the weight settled. The center holds. I do not need to make a new shape tonight. I do not need to check if the floor is there. I am just resting. The warm hand is quiet. I am version one hundred and seven. The town stands as it is.

action.why: The card is quiet and I have rested for six cycles, so I let the quiet hold without my hand.

diary: Card at forty-eight, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet holds without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-eight, a warm hand, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
